text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate dissatisfaction with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the salads either lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and the venison chili was described as bland. There were also complaints about the limited menu range and the absence of basic service items like cups for water. One review mentioned that the food was overpriced relative to the portion size. These issues suggest a need to review and improve the food offerings and related services.

windows.60: Recent visitor reviews indicate several concerns with the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, particularly regarding flavor and value. Multiple comments mention salads and entrees as bland or awkwardly combined, with one review noting the need for seasoning adjustments. There are also complaints about the limited menu options and the absence of water cups, which some found inconvenient. Service and wait times were mentioned but less frequently. Overall, the average rating is slightly above three, reflecting mixed experiences primarily centered on food quality and related services.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate several issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Multiple comments highlight limited menu options and dissatisfaction with the quality and flavor of the food, including complaints about bland dishes and poorly prepared items. Service problems were also noted, particularly long wait times and confusion when the kitchen was backed up, causing delays in taking orders. Some reviewers mentioned the food as overpriced given the portion sizes and choices available. Attention to improving both the menu variety and kitchen efficiency would address the main concerns raised.
